facts.text: Configuration packages contain setup data for a company that can be reused when creating new companies.
Tables with posted entries like customer, vendor, and item ledger entries cannot be imported into configuration packages.
Export requires Direct Read permissions; import requires Direct Insert and Direct Modify permissions for all included tables.
Both databases must have the same schema with identical table structure, primary keys, and field data types for successful import.
Special characters like percent, ampersand, and angle brackets in field names can cause XML processor to remove them and create duplicate names.
BLOB fields use base64 encoding by default; manual conversion required before export if using different encoding.
Configuration questionnaires gather setup information from customers by converting setup table fields into formatted questions.
Configuration templates provide default settings for master data import like customers, vendors, contacts, or items.
